lines.text: Mind the road. Every cell of it costs you.
Knowing is not the same as paying.
Past the crossing the city charges double. Pavement is cheap. Roads are not.
Then I will walk the pavement.
Everyone says that until it rains.
The stall needs crates moved before the light goes.
You carry them. Your arms ache in a way that feels honest.
Fifteen Steps. Do not tell your mother I paid you.
There is always another crate. That is the whole trick of it.
Your mother will cry. Do it in the kitchen so she can pretend she is not.
I will be at the stall. Somebody has to be at the stall.
